finding.title: Forwarding the caller's token (D-8b2878) cannot go through AUTH_EXPR at export
finding.body: D-8b2878 chose to forward the caller's Authorization header "as AUTH_EXPR at export". This target's export accepts AUTH_EXPR only as a static {$env.NAME} and refuses any other value (export-graphos.md § The command), and the @source header is "Bearer {{AUTH_EXPR}}", so a forwarded header value (which already carries "Bearer ") would also be sent as "Bearer Bearer ...". Carrying the choice out needs a schema change instead: replace the Authorization header in @source with one taken from the incoming request (e.g. { name: "Authorization", from: "Authorization" }), drop AUTH_EXPR from template.yaml, and give the local layers (unit, e2e, live) a caller token. That changes the placeholder contract and every test's auth, so the apply of 2026-10-22 left the service token in place; the schema still calls the API as one service account. Until the user confirms the schema-level form (or reopens D-8b2878), every client the supergraph admits can read any customer's orders and IBANs and refund, create or cancel orders.
